# Elite World Estates

> Polish real estate agency in Spain, operating since 2018. Sells sea view apartments, villas, townhouses and luxury villas on the Costa Blanca and Costa del Sol. The team speaks Polish, German, English and Spanish. Slogan: "Home is your castle!"

Contact: +34 672 519 809 · info@eliteworldestates.com

- [Modern Townhouses for Sale in Mutxamel, Alicante](https://www.eliteworldestates.com/properties/modern-townhouses-for-sale-in-mutxamel-alicante.html): new build development of 56 townhouses, 3–4 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, 190 m² built, 2 underground parking spaces, communal pool, gym and social club, from €440,000. Delivery Q1 2028. Reference EWE3910.
